80570.subject: Tether Freezes USDT Tied to $90M in Ledger Thefts
80570.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[Tether](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/tether-freezes-usdt-linked-to-ledger-user-thefts-misttrack-says)**[ froze USDT tied to the Ledger reseller thefts, with reported losses near $90 million](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/tether-freezes-usdt-linked-to-ledger-user-thefts-misttrack-says)

* **[Tether](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/tether-blacklists-four-thorchain-vaults-holding-1-45-million-usdt)**[ blacklisted four THORChain vaults for three hours, then released 1.45 million USDT](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/tether-blacklists-four-thorchain-vaults-holding-1-45-million-usdt)

* **[Mashinsky](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/mashinsky-accepts-lifetime-industry-ban-and-up-to-35-million-in-conditional-payments)**[ took a lifetime industry ban and up to $35 million in conditional payments](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/mashinsky-accepts-lifetime-industry-ban-and-up-to-35-million-in-conditional-payments)

* **[CFTC](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/cftc-excludes-casino-style-wagers-from-swap-definition)**[ carved licensed sportsbook and casino wagers out of the federal swap definition](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/cftc-excludes-casino-style-wagers-from-swap-definition)

* **[Solana](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/solana-schedules-final-cut-to-200-millisecond-slots)**[ finished its slot-time cut to 200 milliseconds, shortening leader windows to 800 milliseconds](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/solana-schedules-final-cut-to-200-millisecond-slots)

Four THORChain vault addresses went onto Tether’s Tron blacklist on Friday morning and came off about three hours later, with roughly 1.45 million USDT still sitting inside them. THORChain’s technical co-founder found out the way everyone else did, by reading the contract’s event log. He got no call before it happened and no explanation after it was undone.

Tether reached for the same key twice on Friday, in opposite directions. It [froze USDT at addresses tied to the thefts hitting Ledger customers](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/tether-freezes-usdt-linked-to-ledger-user-thefts-misttrack-says), where onchain tracker MistTrack puts reported losses near $90 million and Ledger has [asked reseller CryptoBilis to stop shipping devices](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/ledger-asks-cryptobilis-to-halt-sales-amid-reports-of-lost-funds). Hours earlier the same blacklist [caught four of THORChain’s Tron vaults](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/tether-blacklists-four-thorchain-vaults-holding-1-45-million-usdt), pausing Tron swaps, deposits and signing for a protocol that had been promoting that exact route three days before.

The THORChain addresses were part of a sweep that blacklisted 35 Tron addresses holding about 10.9 million USDT. Nineteen of them are still frozen. That sweep lands in the middle of an active argument about who gets to appeal: Conduit [sued Tether this week over $2.76 mill
